content.text:
I removed `acceptance_mode: "MANUAL_REVIEW"` from both discover calls in [NetworkDestinationSearch.tsx](/Users/nandkishorr/work/care/care_fe/src/components/Referral/network/NetworkDestinationSearch.tsx): the one that runs automatically when a referral type is chosen, and the one that runs on text search. The request now sends only `health_service_type` (and `text_search` when there is one).

The type-check reports no errors in that file. I couldn't check the backend because it isn't in this repository, so I haven't confirmed the filter it builds. If it leaves out the acceptance-mode condition when `acceptance_mode` is missing, the filter will be:

```
$.catalogs[*].resources[*] ? (@.resourceAttributes.healthServiceType == "PHYSICAL_CONSULTATION")
```

If the backend fills in a default acceptance mode instead, the `&&` clause will still appear and the change will need to be made in the backend.
